summary: Rivian Automotive, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an underwritten public offering of 75 million shares of Class A common stock at $15.50 per share, with an underwriter option for an additional 11.25 million shares exercised in full. The estimated net proceeds are $1.32 billion, used for general corporate purposes and to fund equity contributions under a DOE loan arrangement. The offering is a routine equity raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. No special category applies.
